fields.score: MusicXML path relative to dataset root
fields.anchor: canonical score-grid position in quarter notes
fields.label: one of NONE/DOWN/UP/CHANGE
fields.label_status: ok | ambiguous_multi_event; coordinate ambiguity is carried by coordinate_ambiguous
fields.supervision_mask: 1 only when label_status=ok and score is evaluation eligible
fields.raw_DOWN: raw start exists at this anchor before CHANGE consumption
fields.raw_UP: raw stop exists at this anchor before CHANGE consumption
fields.raw_types: document-order raw event types at this anchor
fields.remaining_DOWN: start event remains after CHANGE consumption
fields.remaining_UP: stop event remains after CHANGE consumption
fields.change_pair_count: derived stop->start CHANGE pairs assigned to this anchor
fields.coordinate_ambiguous: score contains repeat and is not in the M2 v1 supervision domain
fields.evaluation_eligible: score is Main, non-repeat, printed-pedal, and has no truth outside canonical domain

run_mask_fields.mask: Main 43 membership marker; 1 for Main runs, otherwise 0
run_mask_fields.reference_available: score has at least one printed pedal element
run_mask_fields.evaluation_eligible: run may be used in the canonical evaluation domain
run_mask_fields.supervision_mask: run may be used for M2 v1 supervised training
